groups.topic: Canopus and doubled Goat's tail: old patrons, dignity and wealth

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To Canopus in 8.48 Cancer
claims.historical_meaning_only: The text provides a period zodiac position for Canopus, not modern epoch parity.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: doubling of the taile of the Goat in 18.32 Aquarius
claims.historical_meaning_only: An independently named historic star/asterism shares effects with Canopus.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or to the doubling of the taile
claims.historical_meaning_only: Original 'or' means common description under two distinct placements, not one combined pair requirement.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: procurement of some ancient Clergy-man or Gentleman
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source alleges dignities gained through an older cleric or gentleman.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: ample Dignity or Authority
claims.historical_meaning_only: Promotion and authority claimed.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: great applause glory and fame
claims.historical_meaning_only: Reputation is an asserted outcome separate from a formal title.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: abundance of Wealth
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source includes wealth as another outcome, not quantified or validated.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the Lyons heart in 24 Leo

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: greater Dog-star in 8.53 Cancer
claims.historical_meaning_only: Distinct period star designation and coordinate.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Arcturus in 18 Libra

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: power over the people by authority of some great Prince
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source alleges political authority stemming from a patron.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Office in the nature of a Treasurer

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Receiver of Customes

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Governour of a Town Fort or Castle

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Surveyor of Works Buildings
claims.historical_meaning_only: Surveying is another named occupational outcome.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: employment in abundance from the Nobility and Gentry

groups.topic: Virgins Spike: unexpected promotion and social-class exceptions

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the Virgins Spike in 18 Libra
claims.historical_meaning_only: Spica's period location is presented, not a modern-epoch position.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Unexpectedly Honour or Preferment
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged promotion beyond the person's earlier expectations.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: beyond his hopes or capacity
claims.historical_meaning_only: The source explicitly claims apparent over-capacity promotion, but next constrains actual applicability.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: power of life and death over others
claims.historical_meaning_only: Severe historic authority over others, not real power or safety guidance.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: most Astrologians ... Church preferment
claims.historical_meaning_only: Attribution to historical astrologers is not independent empirical validation.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: according to the Birth or capacity
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author qualifies outcomes by natal/social standing.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: even amongst vulgar persons ... Clowne ... Tythe
claims.historical_meaning_only: For lower-status people source substitutes small-scale parish tithe benefit.

groups.topic: Pleiades at 24°20 Taurus: disputes, allegations and natal precondition

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the Pleiades in 24.20 Taurus
claims.historical_meaning_only: Original 1647 printed Taurus coordinate; no modern astronomical consistency claim.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: troublesome pernicious and dangerous Businesses
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historic language for difficulty, not an actionable prediction.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Wranglings and Controversies
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period forecast of disputes separate from violent crimes.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: occasioned by Women
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historically gender-blaming interpretation, no real-person inference.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: sudden and unexpected Quarrels and rash Actions
claims.historical_meaning_only: Impulsivity/conflict claim with sudden timing, not validated.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: sometimes Murders or Stabs
claims.historical_meaning_only: Extreme unverified dangerousness claims, not real-world risk forecasts.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Imprisonment
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historical confinement claim, no legal probability.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in some Genitures sudden preferment but unlucky end
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source allows initial advancement followed by loss, not uniformly adverse outcomes.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: where in the Radix the Nativity is unfortunate
claims.historical_meaning_only: The last clause conditions the bad-end interpretation on natal misfortune.

groups.topic: Algol's head at 20° Taurus: alleged mortality and benefic exception

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the head of Algol in 20 Taurus
claims.historical_meaning_only: Original fixed-star location historical only; no modern match/parity verified.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: perplexes and casts the Native into extreame danger
claims.historical_meaning_only: Severe threatening historical rhetoric, not individual evidence.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: by reason of Murder Man-slaughter or sudden death

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Native being either author or assistant
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source absurdly attributes perpetrator/accomplice roles; never accuse a person from a chart.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: endangers his Head
claims.historical_meaning_only: An alleged head-injury association, not a health indication.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if other Directions concurre in good
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author explicitly names competing favorable directions as a conditional modifier.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: power of putting others to death
claims.historical_meaning_only: An alternate extreme political/judicial claim rather than simple positive rescue.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: ever found it an ill Direction
claims.historical_meaning_only: Author claims retrospective personal observation; not independent blind validation.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: even in meane mens Genitures
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author claims the interpretation across social strata, still unvalidated.
